subject: Certification milestones & evidence ask — timeline and owners
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cedarbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Cert request — SOC 2 / ISO / FedRAMP pre-assessment

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting a compliance pre-assessment ahead of a security review for our payments platform and need to collect vendor evidence across SOC 2, CAIQ/SIG, and ISO 27001 scoping. Can you share the following by next week?

- A short timeline for cert-related deliverables (what you can provide in 2 / 4 / 8 weeks)
- Owners for each artifact (who on your side I can ping)
- A mapped list of available artifacts (SOC 2 reports, SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet responses, encryption/KMS evidence, access control policies)
- Clarify whether your ISO scope includes Dedicated and Private deployments (VPC/on-prem)

We’ll need items referenced in a vendor questionnaire and a live Q&A call with your team. If there’s a canonical evidence spreadsheet or Drive folder you prefer, please send.

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (list of high-level asks)

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
CedarBank

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cedarbank.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Cert request — SOC 2 / ISO / FedRAMP pre-assessment

Hi Maria — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. We can certainly support this. Looping in Lauren and Rishi to own the artifact collection and the ISO scope question, and Marissa to coordinate the SOC 2 / SIG mapping.

Lauren/Rishi/Marissa — can you please:
1) Confirm what we can reasonably deliver in 2 / 4 / 8 weeks (bulleted timeline)
2) Volunteer a primary owner for each artifact class (SOC 2 bridge reports, CAIQ/SIG responses, KMS screenshots, audit logs)
3) Point Maria to a shared Drive folder or attach an evidence index spreadsheet.

Maria — provisional answers up front: SOC 2 report (most recent) and SOC 2 bridge material: available in ~2 weeks for redacted copies; CAIQ / SIG base answers we can export from our vendor questionnaire tool in ~1 week; ISO 27001 scope: in-flight (we’re targeting certification for core hosted services, and we can confirm whether Dedicated/Private are scoped). I’ll let the squad give firm dates.

I’ll schedule a 30-min sync for next week unless you prefer a different cadence.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cedarbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Cert request — SOC 2 / ISO / FedRAMP pre-assessment

Hi all — quick delivery plan below (owners and rough ETA). I attached a lightweight evidence map (redwood-evidence-map-v1.xlsx) and a rough ISO scope sketch (iso-scope-sketch.png) to speed review. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedDrive

2 weeks (by 2026-10-17)
- SOC 2: redacted latest report (Owner: Marissa Cole)
- CAIQ core: initial export of responses (Owner: Marissa Cole)
- KMS screenshots & key rotation logs (Owner: Rishi Malhotra)

4 weeks (by 2026-10-31)
- SOC 2 bridge notes and control narratives (Owner: Marissa Cole)
- Access control policy docs and RBAC matrix (Owner: Rishi Malhotra)
- Evidence index (spreadsheet populated with drive links) (Owner: Lauren Bishop)

8 weeks (by 2026-11-28)
- ISO: formal scoping statement and any gap-remediation plan (Owner: Lauren Bishop)
- Continuous monitoring artifacts for deployments (Owner: Rishi Malhotra)

Notes / answers to immediate questions:
- ISO scope: currently targeted primarily at our Hosted API and core control plane. Dedicated (reserved capacity) is included in the scoped boundary; Private (customer-managed VPC / on-prem) is out of scope by default but can be added under a contractual scope extension. We will provide a formal statement in the ISO scoping doc at week 8.
- Attachments: redwood-evidence-map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with artifact buckets), iso-scope-sketch.png (high-level boundary sketch)

Action items:
- Maria: confirm if CedarBank needs Private deployments included (that extends work and requires legal addendum)
- Marissa: send SOC 2 redacted copy and CAIQ export to the Drive by 2026-10-17
- Rishi: prepare KMS evidence and RBAC matrix export by 2026-10-17

If that plan looks good I’ll lock the Drive sharing and send a calendar invite for a 30-min Q&A (proposed Wed 2026-10-13 16:00 EDT).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-evidence-map-v1.xlsx; iso-scope-sketch.png

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cedarbank.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Wu <tim.wu@cedarbank.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Cert request — SOC 2 / ISO / FedRAMP pre-assessment

Hi Lauren, Vivek — thanks for the quick plan and the artifacts. That timeline is helpful. A couple of clarifications before the call:

1) CedarBank requires ISO scope confirmation for Dedicated deployments because we host cardholder data tokenization in a dedicated environment. If Dedicated is in-scope by default, we can proceed on the standard timeline; if not, we’ll need to discuss contractual scope extension and possible timeline shift.

2) For the CAIQ/SIG export: can you flag any control responses that are in-progress or depend on product changes (we prefer to see read-only docs and current state, plus callouts for planned fixes).

3) Please add the SOC 2 redacted report to the Drive and set view-only links for CedarBank risk reviewers (HS-1245789 is our internal vendor ticket reference).

I’ll join the proposed 10/13 16:00 EDT call — please send calendar invite and connection details.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
CedarBank
